{"id":1529428556,"question_id":3372,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 5 months","timestamp":1738562933,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1529428556/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Longest Strictly Increasing or Strictly Decreasing Subarray","memory":"27.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int longestMonotonicSubarray(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int inc_len = 1, max_inc = 1;\n        int dec_len = 1, max_dec = 1;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<nums.size(); i++)\n        {\n            if(i+1 < nums.size() && nums[i] > nums[i+1])\n            {\n                inc_len++;\n                dec_len = 1;\n            }\n            else if(i+1 < nums.size() && nums[i] < nums[i+1])\n            {\n                dec_len++;\n                inc_len = 1;\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                dec_len = 1;\n                inc_len = 1;\n            }\n            max_inc = max(max_inc , inc_len);\n            max_dec = max(max_dec , dec_len);\n        }    \n    return (max(max_inc, max_dec));\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"longest-strictly-increasing-or-strictly-decreasing-subarray","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":288}
